snippet.title: What Comes After VR - Official Release Window Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: What remains when everything falls apart? What Comes After is an episodic VR narrative experience set in the ruins of a forgotten settlement, abandoned by the world, but not by those who still call it home. Step into the gritty world of What Comes After VR in this trailer to see gameplay and more. What Comes After VR will be available on Steam VR in Q4 2025.
